# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the Orbit capability or provider boundary it belongs to.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests, lint, formatting, type checks, and package builds pass.
- [ ] Documentation and public API notes match the implementation.
- [ ] Security, compatibility, migration, and operational effects are described.
- [ ] External provider or deployment checks that could not run locally are listed.

## Contract impact

List affected public APIs, lifecycle and failure semantics, dependencies, and release implications.
